properties.name: robot.homed
properties.description: 1 once the robot has been homed

properties.name: robot.faulted
properties.description: 1 while a joint-limit fault is active

properties.name: robot.driverConnected
properties.description: 1 while the motor driver is connected

properties.name: robot.joint1Referenced
properties.description: 1 once J1/X is homed or set to a known value

properties.name: robot.joint2Referenced
properties.description: 1 once Horizontal/Y is homed or set to a known value

properties.name: robot.joint3Referenced
properties.description: 1 once Vertical/Z is homed or set to a known value

properties.name: robot.joint4Referenced
properties.description: 1 once J4/RZ is homed or set to a known value

properties.name: program.runCount
properties.description: Times this program has been started (this run included)

properties.name: program.stepIndex
properties.description: Completed top-level steps in this run

properties.name: program.speedFactor
properties.description: This program's Set Speed Factor (percent, 100 = full speed)

properties.name: aux.AUX_STEPPER_001.moving
properties.description: 1 while aux device 'Aux Stepper' is moving

properties.name: time_ms
properties.description: Unix time in milliseconds (built-in variable; same as $time.now)

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Absolute value

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: Square root

functions.name: pow
functions.description: x raised to y (same as x ^ y)

functions.name: min
functions.description: Smallest argument, or smallest element of a list (0 when empty)

functions.name: max
functions.description: Largest argument, or largest element of a list (0 when empty)

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: x limited to lo…hi

functions.name: round
functions.description: Round half away from zero, optionally to digits decimals

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Round down

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Round up

functions.name: trunc
functions.description: Drop the fraction (toward zero)

functions.name: mod
functions.description: Remainder, same as a % b (0 when b is 0)

functions.name: sin
functions.description: Sine of an angle in degrees

functions.name: cos
functions.description: Cosine of an angle in degrees

functions.name: tan
functions.description: Tangent of an angle in degrees

functions.name: asin
functions.description: Arcsine, in degrees

functions.name: acos
functions.description: Arccosine, in degrees

functions.name: atan
functions.description: Arctangent, in degrees

functions.name: atan2
functions.description: Angle of (x, y) in degrees

functions.name: deg
functions.description: Radians to degrees

functions.name: rad
functions.description: Degrees to radians

functions.name: hypot
functions.description: sqrt(x² + y²)

functions.name: dist
functions.description: Distance between two XY points

functions.name: dist3
functions.signature: dist3(x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
functions.description: Distance between two XYZ points

functions.name: if
functions.description: a when cond is non-zero, else b (same as cond ? a : b)

functions.name: len
functions.description: Number of elements in a list

functions.name: sum
functions.description: Sum of a number list, or of one field of each element

functions.name: avg
functions.description: Average of a number list, or of one field of each element (0 when empty)

functions.name: minOf
functions.description: Smallest element of a number list (0 when empty) — same as min($list)

functions.name: maxOf
functions.description: Largest element of a number list (0 when empty) — same as max($list)

functions.name: rand
functions.description: Uniform random number in [0, 1) or [lo, hi)

functions.name: map
functions.description: Re-map x from one range to another

functions.name: lerp
functions.description: a + (b - a) × t

functions.name: inBox
functions.signature: inBox(x, y, z, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2)
functions.description: 1 when (x, y, z) is inside the box with opposite corners (x1, y1, z1) and (x2, y2, z2), edges included; else 0

functions.name: inCircle
functions.description: 1 when (x, y) is within r of (cx, cy), edge included; else 0

functions.name: .contains
functions.description: 1 when the text contains x, else 0

functions.name: .startsWith
functions.description: 1 when the text starts with x, else 0

functions.name: .endsWith
functions.description: 1 when the text ends with x, else 0

functions.name: .indexOf
functions.description: Position of the first x in the text (from 0), or -1 when absent

functions.name: .toNumber
functions.description: The text as a number; 0 when it is not one

functions.name: .length
functions.description: Number of characters in the text (on a list: its element count)
